# device42_pdu_model (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_pdu_model" "myNewPduModel" {
   name         = "AP8865"
   manufacturer = "APC"
   depth        = "80"
   size         = 0
   width        = 20
   height       = 40
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the PDU model. Create only.

### Optional

- `depth` (String) Depth of the PDU model.
- `description` (String) Description of the PDU model.
- `height` (Number) Height of the PDU model.
- `manufacturer` (String) Manufacturer of the PDU model.
- `notes` (String) Any additional notes for the PDU model.
- `size` (Number) Size of the PDU model.
- `width` (Number) Width of the PDU model.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
